title: Bump github.com/go-acme/lego/v5 to v5.5.2
body:
### What does this PR do?

Update go-acme/lego to [v5.5.2](https://github.com/go-acme/lego/releases/tag/v5.5.2)

### Motivation

- **[lib]** downgrade liquidweb transitive dependency

Related to https://github.com/traefik/traefik/pull/12724#discussion_r4073944208

### More

- [x] Added/updated documentation
